fullDescription:
Alora Serif is a refined, high-contrast serif typeface designed for sophisticated branding and elevated editorial design.

With its graceful curves, delicate serifs, and elegant vertical stress, Alora Serif delivers a timeless yet modern luxury feel. The letterforms are carefully balanced to create dramatic headlines while maintaining readability and refinement.

The Alora Serif typeface is an ideal candidate for minimalist logo designs, luxury branding, and high-fashion magazine layouts. When used as a header, the Alora Serif font creates a stunning focal point, especially when paired with airy white space and a muted, earthy color palette. It is the ultimate choice for designers looking to elevate their work with a touch of modern class and classical proportions, making it a staple for wedding stationery and boutique brand identities.

This typeface shines in large-scale typography, making it perfect for:
• Fashion branding
• Beauty packaging
• Luxury logos
• Editorial layouts
• Magazine headlines
• Wedding stationery
• High-end marketing materials

Alora Serif includes uppercase, lowercase, numerals, punctuation, and extended Latin characters to support multiple languages — making it both beautiful and professionally versatile.

Clean. Elegant. Confident. Contemporary.

Alora Serif turns words into statements.
